title: Spaceship Alchemical Chess Reactor
description: Inside a futuristic spaceship hallway, a holographic chess set serves as the control interface for a molecular fusion reactor. Players must drag chess pieces onto designated reactor nodes to combine elemental reagents, balancing mass and charge conservation laws across multi-step reactions, with full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that loads both GLB assets: space_ship_hallway as the environment and ABeautifulGame (chess set) placed on a glowing pedestal table at the hallway center. Camera starts inside the hallway looking down the corridor with OrbitControls constrained to stay within the hall. Use emissive blue-purple point lights along the corridor walls and a bright white spotlight on the chess set. Implement a reactor HUD overlay on the right side showing 6 reactor node slots arranged in a hexagonal pattern. Each chess piece represents an element: pawns=Hydrogen, rooks=Oxygen, knights=Carbon, bishops=Nitrogen, queen=Sulfur, king=Phosphorus. Display element symbol and atomic mass when hovering a piece. Users click a chess piece to select it (piece glows and levitates slightly), then click a reactor node to place it. Each node accepts exactly one piece. When two adjacent nodes are filled, a reaction line animates between them showing the molecular bond. Implement conservation of mass: a running total displays total input mass vs output mass, and the reaction only completes (green flash) if mass is conserved within the 6-node configuration. Implement charge conservation: each element carries a charge value shown in the HUD, and total charge must net to zero for a valid reaction. Require 10-12 steps: select piece, place in node, repeat for all 6 nodes, verify conservation, adjust if needed. Provide an Undo button that reverses the last placement (piece flies back to board) and a Redo button that replays it. Add a Validate button that checks both conservation laws simultaneously and shows pass/fail with particle effects. If invalid, highlight which nodes violate conservation in red. Track step count in a corner counter. Add subtle fog inside the hallway and animated holographic grid lines on the pedestal surface. All interactions use raycasting. Include a Reset button to return all pieces to the chess board.
